items.title: Pay roof-gutter invoice
items.computation: Start: invoice date 2026-11-20 (Friday). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the event (invoice date) is not counted, so counting starts 2026-11-21. 30 days later lands on 2026-12-20 (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB). 2026-12-20 is a Sunday, so under § 193 BGB the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 2026-12-21. To arrive by then, sending the transfer by 2026-12-18 allows the one business day a bank transfer may take (§ 675s BGB).

warnings: This is a private company's invoice, not an authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies — the 30-day payment term runs from the printed invoice date as the letter itself states.

Before paying, compare the printed IBAN (DE58 3705 0198 0005 5145 00, Musterbank AG) with any earlier correspondence from this roofer to confirm it is genuine; the IBAN itself is well-formed but that does not prove who owns the account.
